message.content:
This editorial illustration depicts a vertical magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, red, serif letters across the top center. Below the title, the date "EDISI 3-9 SEPTEMBER 2012" is printed in small black text. The dominant visual element is a silver and reddish-brown rubber stamp angled from the upper right toward the center. The stamp's circular metal face bears a mirrored, ornate purple script. Below this, a purple ink impression of the word "Banggar" is visible, rendered in a similar cursive style with a stylized icon above the "gg" that resembles two adjacent open books or a peaked roof.

Underneath the stamp impression, the words "BANDAR ANGGARAN" are printed in large, bold, black sans-serif font. Further below, smaller black text reads "Belasan anggotanya terindikasi melakukan transaksi keuangan mencurigakan." Across the top edge, three headlines appear: "MOBIL LISTRIK TIDAK EKONOMIS?" with a small green car icon; "BUMI HANGUS SYIAH SAMPANG"; and "JEJARING KORUPSI HAKIM TIPIKOR". The bottom left contains a price "RP 29.700", a website URL, and a barcode. The background is plain white with a thick red border on the left side.
